proposed_rules.trigger: A top-of-page text node whose content is raw JS source (e.g. starts with 'document.addEventListener("DOM...') rendered visibly, analogous to the confirmed leaked-css-text-node pattern but for inline scripts.
proposed_rules.decision: Exclude entirely from block inventory; treat as a source-leak artifact identical in spirit to leaked-css-text-node.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rendered JS source is never authorable content; appears identically at rc1 on every page in this batch, including this pricing page.

proposed_rules.trigger: A bottom-of-page block with 'The best no-code platform for...' tagline text and a following '| |' separator line, identical across many pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat as global site footer chrome; model as a site-wide fragment rather than page-specific default-content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Content and structure are byte-identical across unrelated pages, indicating shared footer markup rather than page content.

provenance.evidence: C234 rc3c1c1/rc3c1c2 'The best no-code platform for...' + '| |'

proposed_rules.trigger: A pricing page repeats the same '[2x1] plan-name + feature-list' component under 5 separate category headings (Platform usage, Security & compliance, App building, Extensions, plus the top plan-cards block).
proposed_rules.decision: Model each category's comparison as its own instance of a single reusable 'plan-feature-comparison' block (5 instances, one per section), rather than merging all categories into one long master pricing table.
proposed_rules.rationale: Chosen because each category already sits in its own visually distinct section (alternating bg-color) with its own heading, matching heading-then-component-same-section; rejected alternative: a single all-categories pricing-table block with category as a row grouping, which would require a more complex block schema and lose the per-section heading authoring.

provenance.evidence: C234 rc2c3c2, rc2c4c2, rc2c5c2, rc2c6c2 all '[2x1] HIPAA Starter ...' under distinct category headings

notes: Cookie overlay (rc4) excluded per knack-cookie-notice-overlay. FAQ here renders as a 3x3 card grid rather than the vertical-stack accordion seen on C227-C233, so faq-accordion-block does not apply; modeled instead via the generic repeating-cards rule.
